title.narrative: World Food Programme humanitarian efforts in Afghanistan 2022

description.narrative: This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the Afghanistan Humanitarian Response Plan for 2022 including reaching 21.6 million people with food security and agricultural assistance and 5.9 million people with nutrition assistance.

This allocation of 17.5 million DKK to the WFP contributes to meeting the objectives of the WFP in Afghanistan where they plan to reach a total of 23 million people in 2022. In addition, the work of WFP in Afghanistan contributes to the goals of the Afghanistan Humanitarian Response Plan for 2022, which points to 24.4 million people in need and calls for 4.44 billion USD to reach 22.1 million people with humanitarian assistance. The Humanitarian Response Plan aims at reaching 21.6 million people with food security and agricultural assistance; and 5.9 million with nutrition assistance.
This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the WFP in Afghanistan. They plan to reach a total of 23 million people in 2022.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.wfp.org/publications
